CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Tuesday, December 13, 2022
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Maria Teresa Del Rio, Mayor Pro Tem  Ernesto Marquez,City Manager
Jesse Alvarado, Council Member  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney
Victor Farfan, Council Member  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk
Mike Gomez, Council Member
  Luis Roa, Mayor

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The City Council meeting was called to order on Tuesday, December 13, 2022 at 6:02 PM.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, provided brief information regarding the conduct of the meeting.

INVOCATION

The invocation was led by Pablo Rubio, City Clerk.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Mayor Roa.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

  Mayor Roa
  Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio
  Councilmember Farfan
  Councilmember Alvarado
  Councilmember Gomez
ABSENT
  None
Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS - GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

Mike Laughlin, Hawaiian Gardens resident, spoke.

PROCLAMATIONS AND CERTIFICATES

There were no Proclamations or Certificates.

  Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan spoke.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION

A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Alvarado, to
approve the Agenda Organization.

The motion was Carried by the following vote:

AYES: 5; Roa, Del Rio, Farfan, Alvarado, Gomez
NOES: 0;
ABSENT: 0;
RECUSE: 0;

Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0
BUSINESS ITEMS

 1.  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 056-2022 declaring the results of the General
  Municipal Election held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Alvarado, seconded by Councilmember Farfan,
  to adopt Resolution No. 056-2022.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Roa, Del Rio, Farfan, Alvarado, Gomez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

   Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0
 2.  Administer the Oath of Office to the Newly Elected Members of the City Council: Dandy
  De Paula, Maria Teresa Del Rio, Luis Roa, Ernie Vargas.

  Los Angeles County Supervisor Janice Hahn, administered the Oath of Office to the
  newly elected City Councilmember Dandy De Paula.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, administered the Oath of Office to the newly elected City
  Councilmembers Luis Roa, Maria Teresa Del Rio, and Ernie Vargas.
 3.  Reorganization of Members of the City Council.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, opened the nominations for the position of Mayor and all
  committees the Mayor serves on such as Public Housing Authority, Successor Agency
  to the RDA, and Public Financing Authority.

  Mayor Roa nominated Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio for Mayor.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, closed nominations for Mayor.

  A motion was made by Mayor Roa, to appoint Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio as Mayor.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Roa, Del Rio, Farfan, De Paula, Vargas
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, opened the nominations for the position of Mayor Pro Tem and
  all committees the Mayor Pro Tem serves on such as Public Housing Authority,
  Successor Agency to the RDA, and Public Financing Authority.

  Mayor Roa nominated Councilmember Farfan for Mayor Pro Tem.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, closed nominations for Mayor Pro Tem.

  A motion was made by Mayor Roa, to appoint Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio as Mayor.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  Mayor Del Rio

  Councilmember Roa
  Councilmember De Paula
  Councilmember Vargas
  ABSENT
  None
Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced quorum.

PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

 1.  Recommendation to read title only, and waive reading in full and adopt Ordinance No.
  2022-605, amending Title 15 by repealing from Title 15 Sections 15.04.020, 15.06.020,
  15.08.020, 15.10.020, 15.12.020, 15.14.020, 15.20.020 and adding in lieu thereof new
  Sections 15.04.020, 15.06.020, 15.08.020, 15.10.020, 15.12.020, 15.14.020, 15.20.020
  to Title 15 of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code to adopt by reference and amend
  the 2022 Los Angeles County Building Code, Electrical Code, Mechanical Code,
  Plumbing Code, Residential Code, Existing Building Code and Fire Code.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke and provided a staff report.

  A motion was made by Mayor Roa, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, to adopt
  Ordinance No. 2022-605.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Roa, Del Rio, Farfan, De Paula, Vargas
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0
 2.  Recommendation to adopt Urgency Zoning Ordinance Amendment 2022-606 and hold
  a Public Hearing and first reading of Zoning Ordinance Amendment 2022-607,
  amending Title 18 (Zoning), Chapter 18.90 (Supplemental Regulations), Section

   18.90.080 (Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units) of the
  Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code regarding ADUs and JADUs and determining the
  project is exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to
  Section 21080.17 of the California Public Resources Code.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Councilmember Roa recused himself from Agenda Item No. B-2.

  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan recused himself from Agenda Item No. B-2.

  Under rule of necessity Councilmember Roa was randomly selected to participated for
  the Urgency Ordinance.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke and provided a staff report.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Alvarado, seconded by Councilmember Gomez,
  to adopt Urgency Ordinance No. 2022-606.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  NOES: 0;

  RECUSE: 2; Roa, Farfan

  Motion Carried: 3–0–0–2

  That the City Council waive reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions on the

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Farfan, to

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

 4.  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the City Council Special Meeting of

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Farfan, to

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Roa, Del Rio, Farfan, De Paula, Vargas

DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

 1.  Recommendation to adopt the necessary findings for a good cause extension under
  Business & Professions Code section 5273; and authorize the City Manager to take all
  steps necessary to pursue an appeal of the Caltrans Notice of Violation for the Gardens
  Casino sign, dated November 23, 2022.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke and provided a staff report.

  Councilmember De Paula spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Farfan, to
  approve recommendation.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Roa, Del Rio, Farfan, De Paula, Vargas
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;
  Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0
 2.  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 057-2022 denying PLNG2021-0026 (General
  Plan Amendment), a request for a General Plan Amendment, from General Commercial
  to High Density Residential and denying a request for a zoning change (PLNG2021-
  0025) from C-4 (General Commercial) to R-4 (High Density Residential) for property
  located at 12345 Carson Street, Assessor Parcel Number 7066-017-012, City of
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
REGULAR MEETING
DECEMBER 13, 2022 Page 7
   Hawaiian Gardens, California; and finding the same statutorily exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA); and Adopt Resolution No. 058-2022
  denying PLNG2021-0025 (Site Plan Review), a request to approve the site plan and
  architectural design of a new 13-unit apartment complex on property located at 12345
  Carson Street, City of Hawaiian Gardens, California; and finding the same statutorily
  exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke and provided a staff report.

  Councilmember Roa spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Farfan, to
  approve recommendation.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 3; Roa, Del Rio, Farfan
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  ABSTAIN: De Paula, Vargas

  Motion: 3–0–0–2
COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

There were no Committee Reports.

NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items

ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, invited residents to the next Neighborhood Safety
meeting on December 15, 2022, at 6:00 pm, at Hawaiian Elementary School.

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director provided an update on the
Fedde Sports Complex renovation.

CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, congratulated the newly elected Councilmembers and
appointments.

 ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa thanked Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director for
the Christmas events.

Councilmember De Paula thanked the residents of Hawaiian Gardens.

Councilmember Vargas thanked the residents of Hawaiian Gardens.

Mayor Del Rio thanked the residents of Hawaiian Gardens.

Mayor Pro Tem Farfan thanked voters for participating in the election.

Councilmember Roa thanked everyone that participated in the campaign.

CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 7:49 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting
to be held on Tuesday, January 10, 2023 at 6:00 PM.
